race.comment: WAIHEKE ROSE (6) was well supported on debut and didn't lose any admirers when she savaged the line to finish a narrow second over 1400m at Warwick Farm. Tim Clark retains the ride and is expected to roll forward from the sticky gate. Top three contender. SATIN SERENADE (3) no match for the winner on debut when a ($1.35 fav), finishing second to Queen's Gamble over 1300m at Warwick Farm. Kept ticking over with a 1050m trial at Randwick after playing up in the gates and being scratched on September 5. MADE IN ITALY (2) is a frustrating filly looking for this trip second up. Picked up late at the good odds when third in a Super Mdn at Canterbury over 1250m. Track suits from the low gate and don't dismiss. MEMORISE (8) has further improvement to come after she raced on the pace with a narrow second over 1200m at Kembla Grange. Will keep improving as she gets out in trip.
